title: Claude Opus 4.8 launches dynamic workflows #claudeopus48 #dynamicworkflows #anthropic
description:
Anthropic launched Claude Opus 4.8 with stronger benchmark performance, sharper judgment, and better transparency about its own progress. The update also extends Claude’s ability to work independently on longer, more complex tasks.

The biggest addition is dynamic workflows, a research preview feature that lets Claude spawn hundreds of parallel mini-agents to break down and solve different parts of the same problem before combining the results. That shifts Claude from a single-task assistant toward a more scalable orchestration layer for advanced research and development work.

Anthropic also introduced effort controls, giving developers a way to trade off speed, depth, and cost. Low effort targets quick responses, high effort supports deeper reasoning, and a new fast mode runs 2.5 times faster at roughly one-third the cost of the previous model while keeping Opus 4.7 pricing for API access.
